description: Protocol v0: LogisticRegression on raw ['reading', 'delay_ms', 'retry_count'] with SimpleImputer(median) and StandardScaler
rationale: Model fails almost completely to identify faults (only 1 fault caught out of 209). Mixed sensor units and U-shaped fault distributions cannot be separated by linear plane on raw readings.

description: Domain-engineered physical sensor deviations (per-module z-scores, absolute deviations, squared deviations, extreme flags), message syntax decomposition (prefix, payload, redacted flag), and deception interactions with balanced LogisticRegression
rationale: Massive jump in F1 from 0.0094 to 0.6216 (over 65x improvement). Confirms that sensor deviation normalization and message decomposition capture core signal.

description: HistGradientBoostingClassifier with native categorical feature support, 150 trees, max_leaf_nodes=31, learning_rate=0.08
rationale: Outperforms linear classifier in CV F1 (0.6025 vs 0.5836). Captures non-linear feature interactions between sensor deviations, status, and deception phrases natively.

description: Two-model regularized HistGradientBoosting blend: Model 1 (L2=1.5, min_samples_leaf=25, lr=0.05) + Model 2 (balanced class weights, L2=2.0, min_samples_leaf=20, lr=0.06), blended 60/40 with calibrated threshold 0.33
rationale: Highest 5-fold CV F1 (0.6180) and highest Validation F1 (0.6278). Catches 140 faults with controlled false alarm rate. Strongest generalization stability.
